observations: A silver/grey electronic musical keyboard (synthesizer) wrapped in clear cellophane, standing upright against a doorway.
Full-size keys, black and white, with a control panel containing buttons, a data wheel, and a small LCD screen.
Two photos show the same unit from slightly different angles; no power cable, adapter, or stand visible in either shot.
A small logo or text appears near the LCD screen in photo 1 but is too small and blurry to read reliably.
Watermark 'MARY OLUGBAMI POSTED ON ...' overlays both images, likely a reseller/listing watermark, not part of the item.
Background shows a tiled floor and a person's bare feet, suggesting an informal home or shop setting, not a professional listing environment.
Seller's new message is text only, reasserting prior claims; no new photo or video was provided.

read_from: photo 0 overall shape and control layout
photo 1 overall shape and control layout

claims.claim: Quality London used keyboard with super sounds
claims.evidence: No audio or video provided; sound quality cannot be judged from still photos or the seller's verbal reassurance.
Seller says 'I tested it myself yesterday' but no video or close-up showing keys being pressed or a power-on test was sent.
No adapter visible in photo 0 or photo 1; seller's reply did not include a photo of it.
Cannot be confirmed without an audio/video demonstration; seller's verbal claim alone is not proof.
No UK purchase receipt, plug type, or packaging shown in either photo.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have non-functional keys/buttons despite claim.
risks.proof: A video clip of the seller powering it on and pressing multiple keys across the range, including black keys.

risks.risk: Adapter may be missing, wrong voltage, or UK-plug incompatible with Nigerian sockets.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual adapter with plug type and voltage label.

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic or internal damage under the cellophane wrap (cracks, stains, missing knobs).
risks.proof: Photos with the wrap removed, showing the full front panel and underside.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, treated as heavily used

risks.risk: Speaker or sound output may crackle or be dead, contradicting 'no crackle' claim.
risks.proof: An audio/video clip playing a sustained note and a chord through the built-in speaker.

risks.risk: Brand/model unknown, so true market value tier cannot be confirmed (budget vs mid-range keyboard).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand logo and model number, usually above or below the keys or near the LCD.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded keyboard, lowest tier for its size

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model name/logo on the keyboard body.
Video of the seller powering on the unit and pressing a range of keys, including black keys, with audible sound.
Photo of the actual power adapter, showing plug type and voltage rating.
Photos with the cellophane wrap removed, showing the full panel, speaker grille, and underside for damage.
response.reason: A verbal reaffirmation without new photos or video does not change the evidence; the item remains priceable only at its worst-case condition since functionality, completeness, and identity are still unverified.
